title: Widgets should be able to resolve bundled icons and notifyrc files
line: Widgets can now ship their own icon and notification events inside their package.
explanation: A widget's metadata Icon was only looked up in the icon theme (or as a '/'-prefixed path into the package, which the theme can't override), so a third-party widget's own icon showed as blank in the panel and as a generic file in Add Widgets. KNotification only reads knotifications6/<name>.notifyrc from the system data dirs, so a widget's notifications found no event config and were dropped without a trace; developers worked around it by copying files into ~/.local/share from a script. libplasma now adds the package's contents/icons folder to the icon fallback search path and adds every contents/notifyrc/*.notifyrc file as a source of the matching knotifications6 event config when the applet is created; Add Widgets resolves the bundled icon for widgets that aren't loaded yet. The icon theme still wins when it has an icon with that name.

commits.message:
applet: load icons and notifyrc files bundled in the package

Widgets couldn't ship their own icon or notification events, so their
notifications were silently dropped. Add contents/icons as an icon
fallback path and contents/notifyrc as a source for the event config.

BUG: 485340

shellprivate: show the icon bundled in a widget's package

When a widget's icon isn't in the icon theme, Add Widgets showed a
generic file icon. Fall back to the matching file in the package's
contents/icons folder, so the theme can still override it.

BUG: 485340

media.caption: Panel on master: the test widget (Icon "bundledtest", shipped in contents/icons) shows a generic file icon at the right end.
With the fix: the panel shows the icon bundled in the widget's package.
Master: "Send test notification" in the widget's menu shows nothing (log: No event config could be found for event id "ping").
With the fix: the notification appears, with the name and icon from the bundled notifyrc.
Add Widgets on master: generic file icon for the widget.
With the fix: Add Widgets shows the bundled icon, even with the widget not loaded anywhere.

reviews.text: Adding contents/icons and contents/notifyrc to the Plasma/Applet package structure is the right direction, but the runtime resolution relies on fragile global workarounds that a KDE maintainer would not accept as-is. In libplasma, injecting bundled notifyrc files via KSharedConfig::openConfig("knotifications6/...") depends on KNotifications' internal caching/flags instead of adding proper support in the KNotifications framework, allows any widget to inject arbitrary *.notifyrc filenames into other components' configs, and leaves the Notifications KCM unaware of them. Likewise, appending every widget's icons directory to process-global QIcon::fallbackSearchPaths() without scoping or cleanup risks cross-widget icon collisions, and the Add Widgets fallback in plasmaappletitemmodel.cpp omits a pkg.isValid() check and uses an overly broad unsorted glob.
changes: Add proper API/support in the KNotifications framework for loading widget-bundled .notifyrc files (scoped to the widget/component so a plasmoid cannot overwrite another app's notifyrc like plasma_workspace.notifyrc) instead of mutating KSharedConfig::openConfig("knotifications6/...") internals from libplasma.

Avoid leaking widget icon directories permanently into process-global QIcon::fallbackSearchPaths() (or scope/clean up bundled icon resolution so widgets cannot collide globally or leave stale paths after removal).

In plasma-workspace's plasmaappletitemmodel.cpp, check pkg.isValid() before calling pkg.filePath("icons") and filter/prioritize valid icon extensions (e.g. .svg, .svgz, .png) instead of picking an arbitrary unsorted constFirst() from m_iconName + ".*".
